open_claims.claim: Local smoothing, Kakeya and Stein restriction in all dimensions (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Lean proof per OpenAI; no outside expert verdict found as of 2026-11-02
open_claims.watch: harmonic analysts' comments (Guth, Wang, Zahl, Tao), whether formal statement matches the conjecture

open_claims.claim: Existence of QCD and pure Yang-Mills in 4D (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Committee (Gross chair, Douglas, Jaffe, Klebanov, Nekrasov) says it 'appears to be an important step'; plans to validate Lean definitions, then release Lean proof, then assessment with 1,147-page proofs; mass gap and confinement open

open_claims.claim: Quasi-Riemann hypothesis: zeta zeros in strip 1/8-7/8 (Lean) and 1/12-11/12 (informal) (OpenAI)
open_claims.status: Quanta: experts largely agree 11/12 version correct; Radziwill can sketch it; Sarnak withholds 'theorem' until fully checked; private 7-13 page write-ups circulating
open_claims.watch: public human write-ups, any check of the 7/8 manuscript

open_claims.claim: Complete Lean formalization of CFSG (Axiom), with Walter UGT gap and repair
open_claims.status: kernel-checked per Axiom; no outside rebuild yet; formal-statement fidelity not yet human-reviewed; Lyons and Solomon advised on repair

open_claims.claim: AI will weaken lattice crypto within two years (Buterin)
open_claims.status: prediction; no attack on ML-KEM/ML-DSA/unstructured LWE known; Bashiri's provable dual attack (human) explicitly does not threaten them
open_claims.watch: any AI result on standardized lattice schemes
